name: Grandma Dawn Rock Talks About Life

episodes.title: The SSPX is in schism what does that mean for regular Catholics?Avoid them
episodes.description: The SSPX has been in the news and it plays a small part￼ in my story of ending up in a cult. If I can help anybody avoid falling into the pit, that is the SSPX or Sedevacantism it is a good thing.

episodes.title: Steve Hassan has warning signs about cults.
episodes.description: I had to learn about Cults the hard way. There had been signs.

episodes.title: I brought my family into the cult of Sedevacantism.
episodes.description: This cult took over our minds and our home. Thank you God for opening my eyes 🙏
